newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens weaker on Dow downer, BP slides.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens weaker on Dow downer, BP slides.

text.p: The FTSE 100 slid on profit-taking at the start of Thursday's session, jolted by a disappointing close for the Dow, dealers said.
FTSE shares were 22.6 points off at 4,664.3 by 0733 GMT reflecting the Dow's finish at a mere 12 points higher, having traded 52 points up at the London close yesterday.
The fall finishes a record-breaking post-election run.
"The market has had huge momentum and is at its most technically overbought since 1989 and technically and fundamentally it is due some kind of consolidation," said BZW strategist, Steve Wright.
